names.form: Ioan cel Nou de la Suceava
names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 2 iunie, «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Ioan cel Nou de la Suceava».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 12 Ιουνίου, «Άγιος Ιωάννης ο Τραπεζούντιος ο εν Ασπροκάστρω αθλήσας, ο Νεομάρτυρας», with the rank words and the epithets left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 2. јун ст. ст., „Свети мученик Јован Нови Сочавски“ — Свети is not a rank and мученик is a rank word this corpus puts in `types`, so both are stripped; Нови and Сочавски are the epithet and the house, not ranks, so both stay and the form is the fullest the heading gives. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`. A note for §7: the sweep’s known trouble with Јован against John did not bite here, because the day list for the menologion 2/6 already held the folder and no name scan was needed.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 2 iunie — «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Ioan cel Nou de la Suceava»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 12ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Ιωάννης ο Τραπεζούντιος ο εν Ασπροκάστρω αθλήσας, ο Νεομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους» and dates him «(; - 1492)». The Greek calendar keeps him on 12 June where the folder's Romanian row is on 2 June; one attestation row per church is the schema, and the Romanian row is untouched. It is plainly the same man: the learned notable and merchant of Trebizond martyred at Akkerman — Asprokastro, the Romanian Cetatea Albă — whose relics worked wonders where they lay, were buried in a church for seventy years, were then translated with royal honours to Suceava in Moldavia by the voievod Alexander the Good, were carried off to Zhovkva in Poland in 1686 during John Sobieski's campaign against the Turks, and were brought back to Suceava in 1783 by order of the emperor Joseph II. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and no hymn on the page.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 15.06.2026 (2. јун ст. ст.) — „Свети мученик Јован Нови Сочавски“

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, six lines long. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. A THIRD CALENDAR AND A THIRD READING OF THE SAME MARTYRDOM, AND IT DIFFERS FROM BOTH AT NEARLY EVERY TURN. doxologia keeps him on 2 June and saint.gr on 12 June; this book keeps the 2 June, so the Serbian row and the Romanian row carry the same menologion number and the Greek one does not, and each row carries its own day as the schema intends. New or contradictory here: THE ACCUSER IS „некога завидљивога Латина“, some envious Latin, where both earlier pages have the Turkish captain of the ship he travelled on; THE CREED HE REFUSED IS „веру персијску“, the Persian faith, the governor of Akkerman being of that religion, where both earlier pages have him pressed to become a Mohammedan; HE IS TIED BY THE FEET TO A HORSE AND DRAGGED THROUGH THE CITY, which neither earlier page has; and A JEW WHO SAW HIM RAN UP AND CUT HIS THROAT, which neither earlier page has either and which is the book’s own sentence, quoted and not resolved. Also new: the pillar of fire over the body that night and the three light-bearing men about it. A FIRST DATE, AND IT IS THE AGREEMENT OF TWO BOOKS ON A FLAT YEAR. This folder held `dates: null` and its life says why — «doxologia’s life prints no year for the martyrdom itself, only for the journeys of the relics». The Prologue states 1492 TWICE, once in the body and once in its closing sentence, with no „око“; saint.gr’s head line gives «(; - 1492)», which this folder’s own life had already quoted without recording. Two books, one flat year, no approximation: `death` 1492 to 1492, `basis: "traditional"`. THE LESSER RANK IS NOT WRITTEN. The heading says Свети мученик, plain `martyr`, where this folder is kept as a `great-martyr` off doxologia’s «Sfântul Mare Mucenic». Adding `martyr` beside `great-martyr` would demote what two calendars already grade higher, which is the 28 May refusal of `monk` for a Confessor made again. `types` untouched. NO `related` AND NO `locations`. The voievod who translated the body is named „Јоалександар“ here and «Alexandru cel Bun» on doxologia; no calendar read for this corpus keeps him, a translation of relics is not a kinship and not a martyrdom, and the accuser, the governor and the man who killed him are all unnamed. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

hymns.text: Viaţa ta pe pământ bine cârmuind, pătimitorule, cu milostenii şi cu neîncetate rugăciuni şi lacrimi şi iarăşi către pătimire bărbăteşte pornindu-te, necredinţa persienească ai mustrat. Drept aceea Bisericii te-ai făcut întărire şi creştinilor laudă, Sfinte Ioane pururea pomenite.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mare Mucenic Ioan cel Nou de la Suceava; «necredinţa persienească» is the page's own reading, although its life names the fire-worship of the Persians nowhere and sets his trial before a Turkish official.

english.text: Guiding thy life well on earth, O sufferer, with almsgiving and unceasing prayers and tears, and setting out again manfully to suffering, thou didst rebuke the unbelief of the Persians. Therefore thou art become a strength to the Church and a praise to Christians, O ever-remembered Saint John.

death.note: Two books state it flat and the third gives none. Охридски пролог for 2. јун ст. ст., twice over: „пострада за Христа 1492. године у граду Акерману“ and „Чесно пострада и прослави се 2. јуна 1492. године“. saint.gr's head line reads «(; - 1492)». doxologia.ro's life, which this folder was built from, prints no year for the martyrdom at all and only the years of the journeys of the relics, 1686 and 1783. Neither statement is approximate and the two agree, so the interval is the year itself (5 October 2026).
